correctness.rationale: In the original augmented trace code, choose an Fp-basis and the nondegenerate trace-pairing coordinate map phi:F_(p^m)->Fp^m. Each generator column is (phi(x),phi(y),1), hence nonzero and no two distinct defining-set points yield proportional columns: dual weights 1 and 2 are impossible. For gamma=Tr(-beta/alpha), setting y=-alpha^-1 makes the defining trace condition independent of x, so all x occur. For any nonzero t and odd p, the distinct columns at x=0,t,2t satisfy coefficients (1,-2,1), a nonzero weight-three dual relation, giving exact dual distance 3 for every stated p,m,alpha,beta. Independent explicit GF(9) field construction for p=3,m=2,alpha=beta=1 found 33 distinct columns, 80 dependent index triples, and full primal weight enumerator {0:1,18:32,21:96,24:112,33:2}, matching the source formula. This finite instance only checks the all-parameter proof.
